- Mode: streaming
- Requires app: yes
- Idempotent: no
- Destructive: no
- Dry run: yes
- Output: text, json, jsonl

Examples:

- `neon-pilot ask --model opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash --cwd /repo "Summarize the diff"`
